author: Ankit
problem: Read N plate colors, then M color names D_1..D_M, then prices P_0, P_1..P_M: a plate of color D_i costs P_i yen and any other color costs P_0 yen. Print the total price of the N plates.
bug_description: For a color not in the price list it prints P_0 instead of adding P_0 to the total.

comments.accurate: Sums the plate prices, using the default price for colors not in the list
comments.wrong_behavior: Lists the default price for each unlisted plate, then prints the total of the listed ones
comments.wrong_location: Default price handled; check that the color map pairs D_1 with P_1, not P_0
